title: Light shafts and god rays
description: Make sunlight cut through fog in visible rays: shadows, fog strength, contrast and a fog box.

steps.title: Select the sun
steps.text: Click Directional Light in the Hierarchy. This is the sun. The fog is already on, but there are no rays yet.

steps.title: Turn on shadows
steps.text: Set Shadow Type to Soft Shadows. Rays are light between shadows, so the sun must cast shadows.

steps.title: Make the rays brighter
steps.text: Volumetric Multiplier sets how much this light shines in the fog. Try 2 or 3.

steps.title: Darken the fog
steps.text: Select Effects. In Fog, drag Ambient Light Probe Dimmer down to about 0.2. Less sky light in the fog makes the rays stand out.

steps.title: Block the light
steps.text: Add GameObject ▸ 3D Object ▸ Cube. Move it between the camera and the sun and make it big with the Scale tool (R). Rays appear around its edges.

steps.title: Add a fog box
steps.text: Add GameObject ▸ Rendering ▸ Local Volumetric Fog. It is a box of thicker fog. Put it where the rays should be brightest.

steps.title: Look toward the sun
steps.text: Rays show best with the sun in front of you. Hold the right mouse button in the Scene view and turn to face it.
